title: Olfa Risk Score
description: The one JSON shape every Olfa feature returns and the core app consumes.

url.description: The thing that was scored. Usually an absolute http(s) URL; other features may put a message id, a domain or a QR payload here.

level.description: Bucket derived from score. safe < 0.4 <= suspicious < 0.75 <= dangerous.

reasons.description: Ordered, human-readable explanations. Empty means nothing suspicious was found.

code.description: Stable machine key, e.g. typosquat. Used as the i18n lookup key.

message.description: One plain-English sentence for the UI.

details.description: Feature-specific extras (element refs, hop lists, matched brand, spans...).

reasons.message: The domain imitates paypal.com but is not paypal.com.
